item.summary: fix(ui): re-clicking the active nav item no longer stacks duplicate history entries (#123205) Clicking the sidebar item for the page you are already on pushed an identical history entry every time, so browser Back appeared dead until every duplicate was popped. navigateAndWait now downgrades push to replace when the computed target equals the current history location, reusing the existing sameRouteLocation helper; context.replace collapses into the same navigateWithMode owner instead of a parallel copy.
